root.name: Vienna Gambit, with Max Lange Defense: Quelle Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nc3 Nc6 3. f4 Bc5 4. fxe5 d6

overview: White has captured on e5 and Black plays 4...d6 to challenge it at once. White can defend with Nf3 and Black recaptures on e5, reaching open play with the Black bishop on c5. The game is open and tactical with chances for both.

white_ideas.idea: Defend e5 with Nf3 or exd6
Develop Bc4 or Qe2 and castle

black_ideas.idea: Recapture on e5 and develop quickly
Hit f2 with Bc5 and queen

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with the f-file open

gambit.notes: Black regains e5 with dxe5 so material comes back.

sublines_that_differ.name: Main Vienna Gambit
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nc3 Nc6 3. f4 exf4

character.reason: Open tactical play with exposed kings.

gambit.reason: The e5 pawn is regained straight away.

structure.reason: Pawns come off in the centre.
